text:
sofia: Heads-up: PR #4021 is green except integration-redis-flaky. It's holding the merge queue. Can someone rerun or advise rebase window? Planning to land before tomorrow's freeze at 04:00 UTC.

ryan: On it — which job failing? I saw intermittent 'redis connection timeout' in integration:redis-conn-check.

deploy-bot: CI report: PR 4021 — integration-redis: failed (flake suspected). reruns remaining: 2. https://ci.internal/reports/4021

lee: I can trigger a rerun now. If it flakes again, we should request a short rebase window or opt to land after freeze. @anika how bad is this for the release? :eyes:

anika: This PR is the query planner fix, pretty important for throughput. If we miss this release, user-facing perf stays. Can we do a canary behind a kill-switch?

sofia: Yes, canary behind feature flag sounds good. But need approvals + a clean run. @ryan please rerun; if it fails twice, I'd like a rebase slot at 02:30 UTC.

ryan: Rerun kicked: `/ci rerun pr-4021 --job integration-redis`
If it fails twice, I'll escalate to @eng-releases to request a late merge window.

lee: FYI I'm watching the queue; if merge queue backpressure gets above 80% I'll pause other non-critical merges. :warning:

deploy-bot: Rerun started: job id 78912. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/78912

ryan: Second run passed! integration-redis ✅
Running full suite now, ETA ~12m.

sofia: :tada: Great. Can someone add a short note to the release board about canary flag and rollback plan? I'll request a canary rollout at 03:15 UTC if full suite stays green.

anika: Note added to release board. Rollback plan: revert flag toggle + emergency debounce route. I'll be on-call at rollout. :thumbsup:

lee: If anything flakey shows up in canary, we'll flip flag and open a hotfix branch. @sofia, when you trigger, ping here.

sofia: Will do. Last msg — thanks all. Closing the loop: PR merged on green and scheduled canary. I'll update thread after rollout.
